messages:
liam: Hi all, starting today 44b. I found the console but not sure which key to use for early dev work. Do we use a hosted sandbox key or request something else? Also seeing some 429s.
devex: welcome liam! :tada: For day 0 testing use the sandbox key in Console -> API Keys -> Sandbox. Keys look like `sk-sb-...`.
liam: thx. I created one but my script gets 429s after a few minutes. Is there a per-minute rate limit?
nina: yes, sandbox is throttled. Default is 50k tokens/day and ~30 requests/min (sustained). If you're looping with many small requests you will trip it.
liam: I'm running a data prep loop that hits the generate endpoint ~5 rps. That's probably too much. Any tips to avoid spamming?
devex: two quick moves: batch prompts where possible, and add retries. Use a leaky-bucket on the client or reduce parallelism.
liam: Can I get a temporary bump for local load testing?
ops-bot: [ops-bot] To request a sandbox quota bump, file at https://internal.redwood.ai/quota with subject "sandbox bump" and include expected tokens/day + duration. Ephemeral keys available for short tests.
liam: what are ephemeral keys? TTL?
nina: Ephemeral keys are short-lived dev creds for load tests. They default to 12h and can be authorized up to 10x burst for approved cases. Use only for local/dev; they auto-expire.
liam: how to create one from CLI?
devex: CLI command: `rwd auth create-ephemeral --scopes hosted:generate --duration 12h`
liam: thanks. Any recommended backoff strategy?
sec: Security note: never check keys into git. Use full-jitter backoff: base 500ms, multiplier 2, max 12s. Rotate and store keys in the company vault (1Password).
liam: got it. If I file the quota form and tag @devex, how fast do we usually respond?
devex: for new hires we try to approve small ephemeral bumps within a few hours. Permanent sandbox quota increases take 1-2 business days and may need billing sign-off.
liam: are sandbox keys billed?
nina: sandbox is free within quota. Production keys require a billing account and are metered per token.
liam: perfect, I'll try the ephemeral flow first. Appreciate the quick help!
ops-bot: [ops-bot] Reminder: Do not paste secret keys in public channels. Use DMs or the vault.
devex: +1. Also we have a short runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/dev/onboarding-sandbox (contains examples, retry patterns, and the quota request template). Ping us if you need help setting up the CLI.
liam: added to bookmarks, thanks everyone :rocket:
